sections.title: Scoped Format
sections.text: See docs/DEFINITIONS.md for the complete version-1 grammar and native fixture. Root definitions map names to {revision?,parameters?,inputs?,operations,outputs?}. Leaf/use/repeat/forEach nodes compile through the existing batch engine. Named inputs must be bound explicitly. Parameters default locally; child definitions do not inherit caller parameters or locals. Export refs use child.outputs.name or loop.outputs.0.name. Whole-value $param/$input/$local/$ref markers only; no eval or interpolation. Visited nodes and loop iterations share maxExpansion (default 10000, maximum 100000); depth <=128 and copied JSON <=32 MiB. Unknown/cross-scope/future refs, cycles, ID/local collisions, and unsafe markers fail.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Local-only, no --doc/config/backend required. Returns success,status:pass|fail,operation,mutated:false,operations,exports,plan,definitions,documentIdentity:null,associativity:recipeRegeneration,units/frame,provenance:sourceHash/formatVersion,warnings,errors,checks,limitations. Source hash in inspection covers the supplied payload; the durable execution hash is returned separately in recipe.result.sourceHash. This is structural evidence, not model validation. Invalid inputs can omit expansion fields. Geometry units/frame and native associativity follow individual leaf methods.

sections.title: Execution Contract
sections.text: Same shared local compiler and schema as definition inspect. Returns all flattened leaf steps and symbolic exports with full scope paths and mutation counts; does not create a second execution engine. Supply formatVersion:1 for libraries, repeat and forEach. Expanded operation IDs are deterministic length-prefixed scope encodings. Model display names remain explicit user values. Read docs/DEFINITIONS.md for grammar and examples.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: success,status,operation:definition.expand,mutated:false,operations,exports,plan,definitions,errors,checks,limitations,units/frame,associativity and provenance. No native entity resolution, output-field existence checks, report reading/writing or model acceptance. No document/config/backend access, including --preview.

sections.title: Durable Ownership
sections.text: Infrastructure called by batch run/definition instantiate when recipe:{id,bindings} is supplied. begin stores the embedded source/hash, revision and baseline in root fmcad.recipes.v1 attributes before the seed; complete records actual resolved bindings/exports and tags only newly appended timeline entities present in batch created outputs. Binding fields: parameter (root expression string), input (exact dotted leaf data path), target (feature ref), name and/or role (unique native model parameter selector). Existing recipe IDs, changed baseline, ambiguous selectors, unattributed history, missing source or pins fail. Incomplete records are not reused. No implicit save or geometry deletion.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Normal CAD envelope with result:{status:pass,recipeStatus:building|ready,id,revision,sourceHash,documentIdentity:{fileId},associativity:recipeRegeneration,savedToCloud:false,method,atomic:false}. begin/complete mutate attributes; outer transport is not read-only. Exceptions leave partial state; batch records unknown and refuses replay. This command does not execute leaf operations; the existing Node runner owns execution. Read docs/DEFINITIONS.md for limits and the normal invocation through definition instantiate.

sections.title: Guarded In-place Update
sections.text: Requires id, expectedRevision, sourceHash and a saved target pinned with --doc-file-id. parameters is a partial root-parameter map; dryRun defaults to true. All proposed expressions and owned native bindings are preflighted before assignment using the existing feature-edit planner. Explicit dryRun:false edits native model parameters in place, recomputes/checks health, refreshes snapshots and increments revision. Unbound/structural changes require migration. User-edited expressions, changed timeline membership/order, foreign later history, ownership loss, missing or different source and uncertain recipe states fail. The downstream fence is conservative, not a complete SDK dependency graph. Never deletes/rebuilds a component.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Normal CAD envelope result includes status:pass,id,revision,plan:[{parameter,name,unit,target,before,after}],applied,affected,documentIdentity,associativity:recipeRegeneration,units/frame,warnings,provenance,method,limitations,atomic:false. dryRun does not alter the document; --preview is only the generic outer validation. Transport remains conservatively mutating-capable. Errors are explicit exceptions, not successful empty plans. Failed assignment/recompute leaves an updating recipe and possible partial geometry, blocking retry; no rollback or save. Snapshot comparisons cover names, suppression, parameter expressions, sketch control data/points, constraint types/dimensions and occurrence transforms, not every possible SDK property or constraint relationship.
